headline: Six Fronts Intensify as War Enters Day 499
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the most volatile corridors have sharpened. Nevish Line still leads with thirty‑nine ownership changes in the past day; the newest hour shows Colonial losses at 57 per hour and Warden losses at 67, both accelerating, though the two‑hour trend has begun to cool. Callahans Passage remains a meat‑grinder with twenty‑one flips; the latest hour records 591 Colonial and 913 Warden casualties per hour, both accelerating, while enlistments rise sharply. Weathered Expanse has surged to thirty‑nine exchanges; a sudden jump to 449 Colonial and 634 Warden casualties in the last hour contrasts with a two‑hour cooling signal. Palantine Berm holds thirty‑five flips; casualties are steady but enlistments have jumped to 27 per hour, accelerating. Stlican Shelf adds eighteen flips with a fresh hour of 63 Colonial and 31 Warden casualties accelerating, while the two‑hour window shows mixed cooling. Stonecradle reports ten flips, modest casualties now accelerating at 17 and 40 per hour but cooling over two hours. All other regions remain largely static, held wholly by one side with only low‑level attrition.
